label: AbraFlexi Benchmark
info:
Receives AbraFlexi Benchmark results via webhook, aggregates per-cycle
timing data into avg/max/spike stats, then fetches the last 5 created
records of each type from AbraFlexi for inspection.

Source: https://github.com/VitexSoftware/AbraFlexi-Tools

Run:
  make benchmark  (in AbraFlexi-Tools directory)
